'''Ralf Blobelt Cloud City Lift Tubes''' is a [[Light]] deck by [[Ralf Blobelt]], published on [[Trandosite]].<ref name="trandosite">[http://www.trandosite.mcmail.com/ls94.htm Cloud City Lift Tubes], [[Trandosite]] ([[Rod Latham]]). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20001031010748/http://www.trandosite.mcmail.com:80/ls94.htm Internet Archive]</ref>
